chapter: Armstrong, Big Sid and Joe Glaser
title: The Satchmo tribute at the Wilshire Ebell and Joe Venuti
summary: He describes his September engagement, a three-night tribute to Louis Armstrong with Trummy Young, Teddy Buckner and Cozy Cole, plus a blues night with John Lee Hooker and a night featuring Joe Venuti.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Your next appearance is September here, right?
Yeah, September the 21st, I think. MRS BIGARD VOICE: The 19th.
19th. And it's going to be a tribute to Louie Satchmo and it's going to be at the Ebell, the Wilshire Ebell Theater.
And Trummy Young is going to be in it.
Trummy, Teddy Buckner, Cozy Cole, probably either Red Callender or Arvelle Shaw, either one of them. If he can get away from that theater -- MRS BIGARD VOICE: And Dick Carey on the piano.
And Dick Carey on the piano. That's going to be the third night.
The first night they're going to have is a Blues Night and the second night is going to be the Legends of Jazz with Joe Venuti, featuring Joe Venuti.
Have you heard him lately?
Not lately, no.
He's fantastic. That old man is fantastic. He's quite a man. It's a thrill -- I get a thrill

out of listening to him. And he's got all that vim, vop, vip, you know, with him, just like in the olden days. Fantastic. You're not going to believe it. I'm going to get you some tickets and get you -- you got to see it.

So I think it should come out all right, anyway. I mean, -- but I'm not too sure about the Blues Night. But, anyway, it's a good start, you know. They should have some good blues singers, I think. Hooker. You know anybody named Hooker?
Yeah, John Lee Hooker.
Yeah. Is he good?
Yes.
And I think they're trying to get Clean
Oh.
-- David --
Vinson. Clean Vinson.
Vinson.
Yeah. He's been working around town, hasn't he?
Yeah, yeah.
Over or Western Avenue.
He worked -- we worked in Europe together. Keep him off that booze for a while, I mean, he's all right. [Great]
And they got two or three other guys; I don't know, it should be interesting, you know.
Uh-huh.
So --
